senses.gloss: (tradit. pronunc. מַשְׁהוּ) m. (= מַה שֶׁהוּ, v. הוּא) anything, the least portion, minimum.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 35:16">Targ. Y. Num. XXXV, 16</cite>.—
<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 160:3">Sifré Num. 160</cite> <he>הברזל ממית במשהוא</he> an iron weapon may wound fatally, be it ever so small of size.
<cite ref="Pesachim 11b:16">Pes. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>שעה ומ׳</he> an hour and a fraction of an hour.
<cite ref="Chullin 102b:6">Ḥull. 102ᵇ</cite> <he>במ׳</he> when one eats ever so little of it, opp. <he>בכזית</he>; (<cite ref="Chullin 102b:6">ib.</cite> top <he>בכל שהוא</he>).

<cite ref="Chullin 102b:6">Ib.</cite> <he>במ׳ בשר וכ׳</he> when one eats a little of each, flesh, sinews and bones (so as to make up the size of an olive when combined); a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>מַשְּׁהוּיִין</he>.
<cite ref="Eruvin 87a:5">Erub. 87ᵃ</cite> <he>ושני מ׳</he> and two fractions, i.e. ten and a fraction high, and two and a fraction wide.
